listing.summary: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=35993 A small mod I made On every size 6+ planet, there is now an option to visit the gambling den. Inside, you will (in 1.0.0) find 1 slot machine. This slot machine works from "tokens" - Currency you gain by SELLING SHIP HULLS.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a gambling den at ports of size 6 or larger where players can trade ships and blueprints for tokens to play slots.

description:
Gambling Den

A gambling den at every port of size 6 or larger.

Trade in surplus ships and duplicate blueprint chips for tokens, then waste them responsibly on Slots.
Choose one to five reels and stakes of 1, 2, 4, or 8 tokens per reel.

Wins can pay credits, more tokens, weapon crates, or hullmod blueprint boxes.
Hullmod boxes skip blueprints you already know. Win something and you can take it, or double or nothing.

Requires LunaLib.

ScreenshotFive reels, an 8-token stake, a medium weapon-crate win, and the always sensible Double or nothing button.

[close]

Details

Available as a permanent dockside option at markets of size 6+.Sell ships for tokens; fleet points determine value and d-mods reduce it. Your flagship is protected.Each reel rolls and pays independently. If every reel wins, the payout doubles.Weapon crates and hullmod boxes come in three sizes.LunaLib sliders tune crate sizes, payouts, odds, and ship trade-in value while the game is running.No duplicate hullmod blueprints: unavailable blueprint rewards convert to credits.

[close]

Version log

1.0.0

Initial stable release: ship-to-token trading, configurable one-to-five-reel Slots, credits/tokens/weapon crates/hullmod boxes, duplicate protection, and double or nothing.

[close]

The cabinet design is inspired by the Tachy-Impact machine from Interastral Peace Casino by Emanon6 and WolframSegler.

Details
  • Available as a permanent dockside option at markets of size 6+.

  • Each reel rolls and pays independently. If every reel wins, the payout doubles.
  • Weapon crates and hullmod boxes come in three sizes.
  • LunaLib sliders tune crate sizes, payouts, odds, and ship trade-in value while the game is running.
  • No duplicate hullmod blueprints: unavailable blueprint rewards convert to credits.

aiDescription: Provides a dockside gambling option at large markets, allowing the sale of surplus ships and duplicate blueprints for tokens. Players can wager these tokens on slot machines with configurable reels and stakes to win credits, more tokens, weapon crates, or hullmod blueprints. The system includes duplicate protection for hullmods and a double-or-nothing feature for winnings.
